theorem OAllCharacterClosure.both_tests_full_PA_source_zero.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_9 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_10 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_11 : SFinite mu] [inst_12 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ)
  (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi),
  have tests := ⋯;
  have A0 := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (DReview.sharp K phi) ⋯ ⋯;
  have A1 :=
    PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs
      (DReview.sharp K fun x => ↑(Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) * phi x) ⋯ ⋯;
  have S := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  have P := 1 - S;
  (P.comp A0).comp S = 0 ∧ (P.comp A1).comp S = 0 :=

theorem AReview.ArithmeticOrder.both_tests_full_masked_order_remainder.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_9 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [inst_10 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_11 : SFinite mu]
  [inst_12 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (M : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  have tests := ⋯;
  have A0 := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (DReview.sharp K phi) ⋯ ⋯;
  have A1 :=
    PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs
      (DReview.sharp K fun x => ↑(Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) * phi x) ⋯ ⋯;
  have S := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  M (A0 (F - S F)) - M (A0 F - S (A0 F)) = M (S (A0 (F - S F))) ∧
    M (A1 (F - S F)) - M (A1 F - S (A1 F)) = M (S (A1 (F - S F))) :=
